events.title: Tupac Shakur's Tragic Anniversary
events.blurb: On September 1, 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas, dying six days later at the age of 25.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, the music world lost a true icon. Remembering Tupac Shakur today and the incredible impact he made in such a short time.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix today. His influence on music is still felt decades on. What's your favourite Hendrix track?

events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on September 26, 1969, featuring tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun'.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: The one and only Abbey Road! 57 years since The Beatles gave us this masterpiece. What's your go-to track from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the American-British singer, songwriter, and founding member of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever. What's your favourite Pretenders song?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: English singer and songwriter Liam Gallagher, best known as the frontman of Oasis, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad Fer It Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger and the tunes. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: Imagine Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released on October 9, 1971, featuring the timeless title track.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon asked us to Imagine. A song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity.

events.title: iPod's 25th Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple released the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Tech & Tunes Throwback
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? It's 25 years since the original iPod dropped and changed music forever! How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Time to celebrate 007's enduring legacy. What's your favourite Bond film or theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and an iconic solo artist, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy. What's your favourite of his iconic roles?

events.title: The White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968, showcasing their diverse musical styles.

angles.name: White Album Wonders
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unveiled the expansive and eclectic 'White Album'. A double LP packed with timeless tracks and experimental sounds.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991, leaving behind an unparalleled musical legacy.

angles.name: Queen's King
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. His voice, stage presence, and legacy are truly immortal.

events.title: Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: 61 years of 'Rubber Soul'! The Beatles' album that pushed boundaries and set new standards for pop music. What's your favourite from this era?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically killed on December 8, 1980, outside his New York apartment, at the age of 40.

angles.name: Enduring Legacy
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon. His voice for peace and his incredible musical catalogue continue to resonate globally.
